Portronics ChargeMate Trio Wireless Charger – 3-in-1 Fast Wireless Charging Solution

The Portronics ChargeMate Trio Wireless Charger is a premium 3-in-1 wireless charger designed to power multiple devices simultaneously with speed, safety, and convenience. Engineered with a sleek white finish and durable ABS plastic material, this wireless charging station blends modern aesthetics with reliable performance. Whether you need to charge your smartphone, wireless earbuds, or smartwatch, the ChargeMate Trio delivers a clutter-free charging experience for homes, offices, and travel.

Featuring a powerful 15W wireless output, the Portronics ChargeMate Trio ensures fast and efficient charging while maintaining device safety. Its intelligent power distribution adapts to different devices, preventing
overheating, overcharging, and short circuits. The advanced wireless charging technology makes it compatible with a wide range of Qi-enabled devices, making it a versatile choice for everyday use.

3-in-1 Wireless Charger with Foldable Storage Box

The standout feature of the is its innovative foldable storage box design. This compact and travel-friendly structure allows you to neatly fold and store the charger when not in use, saving space and reducing cable mess. Ideal for professionals and frequent travelers, the foldable design ensures easy portability without compromising durability.

Designed as a 3-in-1 wireless charging station, it allows you to charge multiple devices at the same time, eliminating the need for multiple adapters and cables. The minimalistic white color complements modern interiors and makes it a stylish addition to any desk or bedside table.

Fast, Safe & Efficient 15W Wireless Output

With a maximum 15W wireless output, the ChargeMate Trio delivers stable and fast charging performance. Built-in smart protection mechanisms safeguard your devices against voltage fluctuations and excess heat. The charger automatically adjusts power output based on the connected device, ensuring optimized charging efficiency every time.

  • Safety: Overcharge, Overheat & Short-Circuit Protection

Why Choose ?

The is perfect for users looking for a reliable, space-saving, and high-performance wireless charging solution. Its premium build quality, intelligent safety features, and compact foldable design make it ideal for daily use. Whether placed on a work desk or carried in a travel bag, the ChargeMate Trio ensures seamless charging wherever you go. If you are searching for a fast wireless charger, a 3-in-1 wireless charging station, or a portable wireless charger with foldable design, the ChargeMate Trio is an excellent choice. Upgrade your charging experience with a smart, stylish, and efficient built for modern lifestyles.
